title: Fee Carve-Out in a Patient Payment Plan Modification
content:
**Desk guidance — recent plan fees and the balance spread by a Patient Payment Plan modification**

Fees booked on installments within the last 3 months are carved out of the balance that is spread, at a fee carve share: where such fees exist and at least 6 installments were collected by automatic payment within the last 12 months the share is one, where such fees exist and fewer were collected so the share is 0.5, and where no fee was booked on an installment within the last 3 months nothing is carved. The amount carved is the total of those fees multiplied by the share.

- **Fees counted:** every plan fee — late fees and returned-payment fees — booked on an installment whose due date lies fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the handling date.
- **Collections counted:** installments received through automatic payment whose receipt lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date.

## Input, judgement, result

| Fees on installments within the last 3 months | Automatic collections within the last 12 months | Carved out of the balance spread |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 6 or more | The whole of those fees |
| Yes | 5 or fewer | 0.5 of those fees |
| None | Any number | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A late fee of 10.00 and a returned-payment fee of 25.00 on installments due 1 and 2 months before the handling date, with 9 automatic collections in the last 12 months: 35.00 is carved out.
- The same fees with 4 automatic collections: 17.50 is carved out.
- The only fee was booked on an installment due 4 months before the handling date: nothing is carved.
